title: GUI Design Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/gui_design_audit.mjs — a measured summary of a GUI design's contrast, typography, tokens, spacing, touch targets, and interactive states.

textContrastMinRatio.description: Worst-case measured contrast ratio for body text against its background, across both themes.

touchTargetMinPx.description: Smallest interactive hit-area (including padding, not just the visible glyph) in px.

spacingScale.description: The spacing system actually shipped. "ad-hoc" means one-off pixel values not on a grid.

fontWeightsCount.description: Distinct font weights used across the shipped system.

fontSizesCount.description: Distinct font sizes used across the shipped system.

semanticTokensUsed.description: True only if components reference semantic design tokens, never raw hex/px values.

lightAndDark.description: True only if both light and dark themes are designed and contrast-verified (not one inverted from the other).

minBodyFontPx.description: Smallest body/caption font size shipped, in px (rem values should be converted at the 16px root).

interactiveStatesDefined.description: True only if every interactive element defines default/hover/active/focus-visible/disabled (+ loading where async).
